name: Standing machine calf raise
definition: Stand with the forefeet on the calf-machine platform and the pads contacting the shoulders. Raise and lower the heels primarily through ankle plantarflexion.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand with the forefeet on the calf-machine platform and the pads contacting the shoulders.
value.movement: Raise and lower the heels primarily through ankle plantarflexion.
value.finish: Return to the chosen lower heel position.
value.range_of_motion: Record the heel travel; knees remain relatively extended rather than performing repeated squats.
